caption: Savory Chicken & Veggie Toddler Pancakes 🥞💚 Makes 3 small pancakes Ingredients: * 2 tbsp cooked chicken, finely chopped * 2 tbsp steamed broccoli, finely chopped * 1 tbsp cooked mushrooms, finely chopped * 1 egg * Small handful of shredded cheddar or mozzarella cheese * 3 tbsp whole wheat flour * 2 tbsp whole milk * Dash of garlic powder * Olive oil for cooking Instructions: 1. Finely chop the chicken, broccoli, and mushrooms. 2. Add all ingredients to a bowl and mix until well combined. 3. Heat a lightly oiled nonstick pan over low-medium heat. 4. Scoop about 2 tablespoons of batter per pancake and gently flatten. 5. Cook for 3–4 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. 6. Let cool before serving.
